sectorScreen.note: Fetches real 47-criterion Sector-Screen data directly from the SectorScreenWeb GitHub repo. The nested {sectors: {...}} format is auto-flattened by app.js.

verdictRules.BUY: J-Curve stage 2 + score >= 75, and not flagged by Sector-Screen
verdictRules.WATCH: J-Curve stage 1 with score 65-79, or stage 2 with mixed Sector-Screen signal
verdictRules.HOLD: J-Curve stage 3 (already re-rated) or strong Sector-Screen with weak J-Curve
verdictRules.AVOID: J-Curve score < 60, or redFlags present, or Sector-Screen flagging decline
